svg.aria-label: Step-by-step mechanism of the Cannizzaro reaction with curved arrows
svg.title: Step-by-step mechanism of the Cannizzaro reaction with curved arrows

g.text: Mechanism of the Cannizzaro reaction (benzaldehyde, conc. NaOH)
Step 1: hydroxide adds to the C=O of one molecule (fast, reversible)
Step 2 (rate-determining): hydride ion (H−) is transferred from anion A to a second molecule of benzaldehyde
Step 3: fast proton transfer – the acid is stronger than the alkoxide base, so equilibrium lies far to the right
benzoate ion (→ benzoic acid with HCl)
Kinetics: rate = k [ArCHO]² [OH−] (second order in aldehyde, first order in base)
